title: Show details of a specific login session
summary: Display all properties and settings for a specific login session identified by its session ID.

steps.explain: Use loginctl show-session with the session ID to display its properties. Add --all to show all properties, not just non-default ones.

placeholders.name: SESSION_ID
placeholders.description: The ID of the session to inspect

alternatives.explain: Display information about the current session using the session ID environment variable.
alternatives.expect: Output lists properties like 'Type=x11' or 'Type=wayland', 'State=active', and 'Scope=session-...'.
